name: ranged_sustained_fire
about: An NPC's clip never runs down: it fires an eighth shot from a six-round weapon. The ranged_open_fire staging (a hostile TutorialThug gunman with item_w_thirtyeight, Size 6, fighting from the open at ~387 units), run long enough for eight shots. Retail fills an NPC's clip once, at equip (Inventory_Insert 0x10334e70: max(Default_Size, 1)), and CWeaponRanged's Shot 0x102387b0 subtracts Ammo_Cost only inside its player block (0x10238a15): an NPC wielder's clip never drops, so NO_PRIMARY_AMMO (0x40) cannot rise from firing and no reload is ever scheduled by it (stories/v4/packets-S4.md item a; stories/v1/triage.md, Judge's rulings, V4 -- second sitting, J12). Each shot is the attack clip's 3031 event (smith_attack authors 3031 at cycle 0, male move_and_ranged) through CWeaponRanged's operator 0x10238160. Eight animevent 3031 on the shooter, never cond+ NO_PRIMARY_AMMO, never TASK_RELOAD.
notes: Staging (V4o): since the event shot (CWeaponRanged 0x10238160 -> Shot 0x102387b0) an NPC's 3031 commits its bullets, 15 a set from the .38 here, and a 100-health player dies at the seventh; the record is about the gunman, so the player is held by retail's own unkillable latch, an events_player row's MakePlayerUnkillable input, from t=0.05. Green since V5a + A3 (slot 363: no BEHIND_ENEMY). Its 3031s are still the world-tick poll's: no NPC shot runs through the weapon yet (V4a lane A1, V4o lane O3), so no clip is spent. When O3 lands the event shot it must keep this green (J12: an NPC's clip never drops, Shot 0x102387b0's spend is inside its player block 0x10238a15). The BEHIND_ENEMY never is ranged_open_fire's (the player faces the gunman): it is why the record's first red is V4a's slot 363. The 8 s between shots admits TASK_WAIT_ATTACK_TIME1's longest wait at this range (NPC_Attack_Rate_Max 2.5 scaled up with range) plus the attack clip.
